title: Auto crouch mod
description: This mod allow the player to auto crouch at the edge of a block. This is a client-side mod and is compatible with almost any mods. The default keybind is Left Alt which can be changed in the minecraft settings.
body:
Automatically crouches near block edges to prevent accidental falls while building and bridging.
![Enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cb945cdf5194518941e765b029be1b6144bbeec.webp)
![Disabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3be0e8cb934c9a0b4169c8e77bd35e3ca4c3befa.webp)

This mod allow the player to auto crouch at the edge of a block. This is a client-side mod and is compatible with almost any mods. The default keybind is Left Alt which can be changed in the minecraft settings.

[More Description](https://github.com/NoOne-is-here/Auto-crouch-mod/blob/main/README.md)
